Use case: stylized-concept. A beautiful polished hand-painted cute storybook game ANIMAL sprite sheet. Exactly 5 rows, eight columns, no humans. One distinct animal species and anatomy per row, same identity in every cell. Entire body, ears, tail, wings, feet must be visible, never cropped or overlapping. Generous 15 percent clear transparent gutters between all cells and 5 percent outside margin. Genuine transparent alpha, NO scenery, labels, boxes, grid lines or cast shadows. Three-quarter elevated view facing right, crisp dark soft outlines, warm appealing painted details. First four columns are a smooth moving cycle, last four are another species-appropriate action loop. Clear motion changes, not copied poses. All EIGHT poses and ALL 5 rows, including the final row, fully drawn. Distinct real anatomies and silhouettes, no recolours.
